fullPassage: Wakeville High School is holding a school bell sound contest. The theme of this contest is Happy School Life. Deadline: December 12, 2025. Participants: Wakeville High School students of all grades. Application Details: Submit entries in MP3 format only. Upload entries to our school website (file size limit: 1MB). Include the description of the sound creation process. Selection Method: Three school bell sounds will be selected by student vote, based on creativity and suitability. Awards: The winning school bell sounds will replace our current bell sounds. The winners of the contest will each get a wireless speaker.

questions.passage: Wakeville High School is (A)[holding / canceling] a school bell sound contest. The theme of this contest is Happy School Life. Deadline: December 12, 2025. Participants: Wakeville High School students of all grades. Application Details: Submit entries in MP3 format only. Upload entries to our school website (file size limit: 1MB). Include the description of the sound creation process. Selection Method: Three school bell sounds will be selected by student vote, based on (B)[originality / creativity] and suitability. Awards: The winning school bell sounds will (C)[remove / replace] our current bell sounds. The winners of the contest will each get a wireless speaker.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① canceling(취소하는) — creativity(창의성) — replace(교체하다): (A) canceling은 holding의 반의어
❌ ② holding(개최하는) — originality(독창성) — replace(교체하다): (B) originality는 유의어이나 원문은 creativity
✅ ③ holding(개최하는) — creativity(창의성) — replace(교체하다): 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ holding(개최하는) — creativity(창의성) — remove(제거하다): (C) remove는 '제거'로 '교체'와 다름
det.tip: hold a contest(대회를 개최하다), creativity(창의성), replace(교체하다)

questions.passage: Wakeville High School is holding a school bell sound contest. The theme of this contest is Happy School Life. Deadline: December 12, 2025. ❌ ② rejected(거부된) — suitability(적합성) — wireless(무선): (A) rejected는 반의어
❌ ③ selected(선정된) — inability(무능력) — wireless(무선): (B) inability는 적합성과 무관한 반의어
❌ ④ selected(선정된) — suitability(적합성) — wired(유선): (C) wired는 반의어
det.tip: selected by student vote(학생 투표로 선정), suitability(적합성), wireless speaker(무선 스피커)

questions.passage:
(A) Wakeville High School is holding a school bell <u>sound</u> contest to find new bell sounds.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 sound가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ③ (A) 건전한 — (B) 소리: (A) bell sound = 벨소리
❌ ④ (A) 건전한 — (B) 건전한: (A)는 명사 '소리'
